reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Craigslist offers an official Bulk Posting Interface/Bulkpost API for high-volume paid posters (e.g. for-sale-by-dealer), granted case-by-case; no search/read API.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://www.craigslist.org/about/bulk_posting_interface): Craigslist offers an official Bulk Posting Interface/Bulkpost API for high-volume paid posters (e.g. for-sale-by-dealer), granted case-by-case; no search/read API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
